DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った携帯電話を届けに来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to hand in a mobile phone you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。届ける途中で電話が鳴り、持ち主という人と話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得携帯の持主と電話した経緯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It rang on the way here, and I spoke to someone saying they were the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain speaking by phone with the person claiming ownership of the found mobile. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方には、どのようにお答えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you tell that person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 警察へ届けると言いました。今夜、本人が取りに来たいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 警察へ届けると伝えた受取希望を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I said I would hand it to the police. They apparently want to collect it themselves tonight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report saying you would take it to police and the requested pickup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認と返却は、こちらで扱います。お電話では、この警察署の名前を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We handle identity checks and return here. Did you tell them this police station's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前までは知りませんでした。近くの警察へ届けるとだけ言ったので、行き先が分からないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 具体的な届け先を伝えていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not know its name. I only said the nearby police, so I think they do not know where it is going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you did not give the specific destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先ほどの着信履歴があれば、担当が確認します。今は電話機をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the incoming-call history remains, staff will check it. We will take the phone now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのままお渡しします。次に鳴った時も、受取場所をこちらから伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話機を渡し次の連絡対応を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hand it over as it is. If it rings again, could you tell them the pickup location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over the phone and request handling the next contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応は担当へ引き継ぎます。持ち主という方が話した内容を、もう少し教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will hand this to the staff in charge. Tell me a little more about what the person claiming ownership said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕事帰りの七時ごろに来たいと言っていました。時間は相手の希望で、こちらと決まったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来署希望時刻と未確定の約束を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: They wanted to come around seven after work. That was their preferred time; it was not agreed with you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the desired police-station visit time from an unconfirmed arrangement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お話を引き継ぎます。お届けいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass on your account. Thank you for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後のお荷物についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a parcel after moving house?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 郵便は届くのですが、通販の荷物だけ前の家に配達されました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵便だけ転送され荷物が旧住所へ届いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mail reaches me, but an online-shopping parcel was delivered to my old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say only mail was forwarded and the parcel went to the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送した会社の追跡画面はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the shipping company's tracking screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。転居届を出したので、荷物も全部来ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追跡画面を示し転居届の範囲の認識を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I filed a moving notice, so I thought all parcels would come too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the tracking screen and explain your understanding of the moving notice's scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで扱う荷物か、まず発送方法を確認します。この便は別の配送会社です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will first check the shipping method to see if it is handled by us. This delivery uses another company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 違う会社だったのですね。前の家の人に受け取ってもらったので、配送会社へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別会社配送と理解し受取相談先を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it was a different company. Someone at my old home received it, so I will consult that delivery company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand delivery is by another company and decide whom to ask about receiving it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通販の登録住所も変更されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you changed your registered online-shopping address too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。いつも選ぶ配送先が前の住所のままでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通販の保存先が未変更と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. The delivery address I always select was still the previous one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the saved online-shopping destination is unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録住所と注文時の配送先は、両方ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check both the registered address and the destination for each order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回の受取方法は配送会社と相談して、次の注文前に保存した配送先も直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現荷物の相談と次回配送先修正を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will discuss collecting this parcel with the delivery company and correct the saved destination before the next order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult about the current parcel and correct the next delivery address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それがよいですね。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: That sounds good. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 印鑑についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your personal seal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 登録した印鑑の端が欠けました。まだ押せますが、新しい印鑑へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠けた届出印の変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: An edge of my registered seal chipped. It still stamps, but I want to change to a new seal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request replacing the chipped bank-registered seal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いの通帳と、欠けた印鑑をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the passbook you use and the chipped seal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。新しい印鑑も持参しました。元の印と少し違う形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳旧印新印と形の相違を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both. I also brought the new seal. Its shape is slightly different from the old impression.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the passbook, old seal, new seal, and their shape difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更担当が印影と必要書類を確認します。本人確認書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff handling changes will check impressions and documents. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 免許証があります。欠けたまま押すと違う印に見えるので、今日は出金していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認書類と出金保留を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my driver's license. Stamping with the chipped one looks different, so I have not withdrawn money today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give identification and say you held off withdrawing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで印を照合してから手続きをご案内します。新しい印はほかでも使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will compare the seal and explain the procedure. Do you also use the new seal elsewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 市に登録した印とは別です。銀行の届出印だけを、この新しい物へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行届出印だけの変更と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is separate from the seal registered with the city. I want to change only the bank seal to this new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain only the bank-registered seal is to change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つを取り違えないよう、古い方をこちらの皿へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. To avoid mixing them up, put the old one on this tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 欠けた方を皿に置きました。新しい方はケースに入れ、担当の確認を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧印と新印を分けて担当確認を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the chipped one on the tray. The new one is in its case, ready for staff to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate old and new seals for staff confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通帳と書類も担当へお渡しください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Give your passbook and documents to the staff too. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍食品についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about frozen food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この野菜を弁当に入れたいです。自然解凍の表示はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍野菜の自然解凍表示を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want these vegetables for a bento. Where is the natural-thawing label?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for the frozen vegetables' natural-thawing indication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品は加熱してお召し上がりくださいと書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product says to heat it before eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝、凍ったまま弁当に入れる商品ではないのですね。別の商品ならできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 加熱用と理解し代替商品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not meant to be put frozen in a bento in the morning. Is there another product that can?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand it requires heating and ask for an alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらには自然解凍で使えるとあります。袋の使用例もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one says it can be used after natural thawing. Look at the usage example on the bag too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらにします。必要な分を取り出した後、残りは冷凍庫へ戻すのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 選んだ商品の残りの保管を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take this. After removing the amount needed, I put the rest back in the freezer, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm storage of the remaining chosen product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、残りは凍った状態で保管してください。解けた物を再び凍らせないよう表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, keep the remainder frozen. The label says not to refreeze anything that has thawed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家まで四十分ほどです。保冷バッグに入れて持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅時間と保冷バッグ利用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Home is about forty minutes away. I want to take it in a cooler bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State travel time home and use of a cooler bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 冷凍品用の保冷剤をレジでお求めいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can buy an ice pack for frozen products at the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自然解凍できるこちらと保冷剤を買います。買物の最後に冷凍棚から取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自然解凍商品と保冷剤を最後に購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy this naturally thawable product and an ice pack. I will take it from the freezer shelf at the end of my shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy the naturally thawable product and ice pack at the end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。保冷剤はレジでお申し付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Ask at the checkout for the ice pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩のコースをご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at walking routes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 杉の木が少ない道を歩きたいです。花粉で目がつらくなりやすいので。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 杉の少ない散歩道を希望し理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a path with few Japanese cedar trees. Pollen tends to make my eyes uncomfortable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a walk with fewer cedars and give your reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 北の林には杉があります。池の周りは開けていますが、花粉がないとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The northern woods have cedars. The pond area is open, but we cannot say it has no pollen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の道にします。途中でつらくなったら、短く戻れる分かれ道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池の道を選び途中の短縮経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will choose the pond path. Is there a junction to return by a shorter route if I feel unwell midway?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the pond path and ask for a shortcut partway through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 半周した所に、管理棟へ戻る近道があります。赤い橋の手前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Halfway around, a shortcut returns to the management building. It is before the red bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋を渡らず曲がるのですね。管理棟には休める屋内の場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近道の曲がり方と屋内休憩を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I turn without crossing the bridge. Is there an indoor resting place in the management building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the shortcut turn and an indoor rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口の休憩室をご利用いただけます。今日は四時まで開いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use the rest room at the entrance. It is open until four today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は三時なので、二十分ほど歩いて休憩室へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩室の時間内に戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is three now, so I will walk about twenty minutes and return to the rest room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return within the rest room's hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら池を一周せず、赤い橋から戻るコースが合いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then the route returning from the red bridge, rather than the whole pond, seems suitable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのコースにします。入口と赤い橋を案内図で確認してから出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 橋から戻るコースを案内図で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take that route. I will check the entrance and red bridge on the map before setting out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the route returning from the bridge on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ無理のない範囲で。よいお時間を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stay within what is comfortable. Have a pleasant time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お降りになったお客様ですか。出口をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you just left the train? Shall I show you the exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。スーツケースが重いので、階段を使わずに東改札へ出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い荷物があり東改札まで階段を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My suitcase is heavy, so I want to reach the east ticket gates without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention heavy luggage and request avoiding stairs to the east gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このホームの南側にエレベーターがあります。青い案内板のほうへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an elevator on the south side of this platform. Head toward the blue sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南側というのは、売店があるほうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 南側が売店の側か聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is south the side with the shop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether south is the shop side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売店とは反対側です。ホームの端に、青い案内板が見えますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is the opposite side from the shop. You can see a blue sign at the platform end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あの青い板ですね。エレベーターを降りたら、どちらへ曲がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内板を特定し降りた後の方向を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: That blue sign, then. Which way do I turn after getting out of the elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the sign and ask which way to turn after descending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 右へ曲がると東改札です。途中に待合室もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Turn right for the east gates. There is a waiting room on the way too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を持ち直したいので、待合室で少し休んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待合室で荷物を持ち直して休めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to adjust my grip on the luggage. May I rest briefly in the waiting room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to rest and readjust luggage in the waiting room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、通路をふさがないように荷物を置いてお休みください。改札はその先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Put luggage where it does not block the passage and rest. The gates are further ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、青い板のほうへ行って、下で右に曲がります。助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 進む方向を言い直して礼を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will head toward the blue sign, then turn right below. That helps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat your direction and give thanks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけて。よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入届をお書きですね。どの欄でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are filling out a moving-in notice. Which section is difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所の欄です。建物の名前が長くて、全部入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所欄に建物名が入りきらないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The new-address section. The building name is too long to fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the building name does not fit the address field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物名と部屋番号は、この下の欄にも続けて書けます。住所がわかるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can continue the building name and room number in the field below too. Do you have something showing the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 賃貸契約書を持っています。このページを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書の住所を職員に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my rental contract. Could you look at this page?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show staff the contract's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、こちらですね。部屋番号まで省略せずに書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, here. Write it without omitting the room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋番号は三〇二です。前の住所も建物名まで書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号を伝え旧住所の記入範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The room number is302. Do I write the building name for the previous address too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the room number and ask how much of the old address to write. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 前の住所は、持参された転出の書類と合わせて記入してください。書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write the old address to match the moving-out documents you brought. Do you have them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、これです。保険の相談は、この届を出した後にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転出の書類を示し保険相談の順序を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, these. Can I ask about insurance after submitting this notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the moving-out documents and ask the order of insurance consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所の受付が済んだら、保険の担当窓口をご案内します。必要な手続きはそちらで伺ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the address is accepted, we will guide you to the insurance counter. Ask there about necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。まず住所を最後まで書いて、こちらの窓口に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届の記入と提出を先に行うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. First I will complete the address and submit it at this counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will complete and submit the notice first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、記入が終わったらお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, bring it when finished. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再診のご予約を変更されたいのですね。診察券をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change your follow-up appointment. Your patient card, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。水曜日の朝に仕事が入ったので、午後に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察券を渡し仕事のため午後へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here. Work came up on Wednesday morning, so I want to change to the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand over the card and request an afternoon appointment due to work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在は十四日水曜日の九時ですね。同じ先生の午後は、翌週の二十一日十五時に空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Currently nine on Wednesday the14th. The same doctor has an opening at fifteen on the21st next week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 翌週でも構いません。同じ先生の十五時でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌週の同じ医師の枠を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next week is fine. Please book fifteen with the same doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the next-week slot with the same doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二十一日の十五時ですね。前回から症状に変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Fifteen on the21st. Has anything changed in your symptoms since last time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 痛みが前より強くなっています。予約を遅らせてよいか、先生に聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みが強くなったと伝え延期の判断を医師に依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The pain has become stronger. Could you ask the doctor whether it is all right to postpone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report increased pain and ask the doctor to judge the postponement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更する前に、担当医へその点を伝えます。痛みはいつから強くなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before changing, we will tell the doctor. When did the pain increase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の夜からです。朝の予約は、先生のお返事があるまで残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変化の開始時期を伝え現在の予約を残すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Since last night. I want to keep the morning appointment until the doctor replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State when the change began and ask to keep the current appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の予約は残します。担当医からの連絡を受けられる電話番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will keep it. Give us a number where you can receive the doctor's call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 登録してある携帯電話で受けられます。今日の十七時までは出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録電話と連絡を受けられる時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The registered mobile number is fine. I can answer until seventeen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the registered phone and available contact hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その時間も添えて伝えます。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will include that time when passing it on. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないということですね。最後に見た場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing, correct? Where did you last see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅前の駐輪場です。昨日の十八時に停めて、今朝八時に戻ったらありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車を停めた場所と発見時刻を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle parking by the station. I parked at eighteen yesterday and returned at eight this morning to find it gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the bicycle's parking location and discovery time precisely. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駐輪場の管理の方には、移動されていないか聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you asked the parking manager whether it was moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 係の方は移動していないと言っていました。周りの列も探しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理者への問い合わせと周囲を探した結果を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said it had not been moved. I looked in surrounding rows too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report asking management and searching nearby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自転車の特徴がわかる写真や書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have photographs or documents identifying it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い自転車で、前のかごが白です。写真と防犯登録の控えがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体の色とかごの特徴を伝え写真と登録控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is blue with a white front basket. I have a photo and the anti-theft registration copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the bicycle color and basket features and show the photo and registration copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拝見します。停めた位置と、鍵の状態も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me see. Also tell me the parking position and lock condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図のこの屋根の下です。後ろの車輪の鍵をかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図で位置を示し施錠状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Under this roof on the map. I locked the rear wheel lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the map position and explain locking it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況を記録します。登録の住所は、今のお住まいと同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record that. Is the registered address the same as your current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 違います。先月引っ越したので、今の住所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録住所と現住所が違うと伝え現住所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I moved last month; my current address is here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the registered and current addresses differ and show the current one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。追加で伺うことがあればご連絡しますので、今日はお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will contact you if more questions arise. Take care on your way home today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお送りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申込書を送ります。提出先から、郵便局で出した日がわかる控えを残すように言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申込書と発送日がわかる控えの必要性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: An application form. The recipient told me to keep proof showing the day it was sent at the post office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the application form and need for a record showing the mailing date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その案内を見せていただけますか。配達の記録についても指定がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see those instructions? Is a delivery record required too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この部分です。受け取った人の名前までは求められていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内を示し受取人名の記録は不要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This part. They do not require the name of the person receiving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the submission instructions and explain no recipient-name record is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差し出した記録と配達状況を確認できる方法をご案内します。いつまでに先方へ届く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will describe a method with mailing records and delivery tracking. By when must it arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜日までです。今日出すと間に合うか、目安を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着期限を伝え所要日数の目安を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Friday. If I send it today, please give me an estimate of whether it will make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the arrival deadline and ask the estimated transit time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あて先の郵便番号からお調べします。日数は目安ですので、到着の保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the destination postal code. Times are estimates; arrival cannot be guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 郵便番号はこの欄です。見込みを聞いてから、送る方法を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵便番号を示し見込みを聞いて方法を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The postal code is in this field. I want to hear the estimate before deciding the method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the postal code and say you will decide after hearing the estimate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの方法なら通常は明後日が目安です。料金と、受付の控えの見本はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: With this method, normally the day after tomorrow is the estimate. Here are the price and a sample acceptance receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。控えは提出先への連絡用に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された方法を選び控えを持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please use that method. I will take the receipt home to contact the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the explained method and say you will take the receipt home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えをお渡ししますので、大切に保管してください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will give you the receipt. Keep it carefully. Thank you.
